source_rules.description: If the source number has an immediately adjacent dollar sign and that sign is the only difference between the quoted text and its specified source location, remove it from the computation-only quotation.

rules.description: Trim boundary whitespace in computation values only.
Remove a recognized currency prefix from a complete numeric amount; preserve signs and source text.
Remove a trailing percent sign from the computation value only. 25% represents 25 in percentage units; do not convert it to 0.25.
Remove thousands-separator commas from computation values only. Preserve source text and raw model responses.
